The singer—**Eric Carmen**—was born in Cleveland, Ohio, which lies within **Cuyahoga County**.  
A county that shares a border with Cuyahoga County is **Summit County** (other bordering counties include Lake, Geauga, Lorain, and Medina, but Summit is the most commonly referenced one).
